glossary.definition: (1) "Peace officer" has the same meaning as in section 2935.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 2941.1414 - Peace officer victim of aggravated vehicular homicide specification.

glossary.definition: (2) "Investigator of the bureau of criminal identification and investigation" has the same meaning as in section 2903.11 of the Revised Code.
glossary.normalized: investigator of the bureau of criminal identification and investigation
glossary.source_title: Section 2941.1414 - Peace officer victim of aggravated vehicular homicide specification.
glossary.term: Investigator of the bureau of criminal identification and investigation

glossary.definition: (3) "Firefighter" means a firefighter, whether paid or volunteer, of a lawfully constituted fire department.
glossary.source_title: Section 2941.1414 - Peace officer victim of aggravated vehicular homicide specification.

glossary.definition:
(4) "Emergency medical worker" means a first responder, emergency medical technician-basic, emergency medical technician-intermediate, or emergency medical technician-paramedic, certified under Chapter 4765. of the Revised Code, whether paid or volunteer.
